name: footer-link-rows
title: Footer with link rows
description: A footer that sets link groups as labelled rows instead of columns, for sites with a few short groups and room to breathe.
docs: Each group is a label and its links; the label sits on the left and the links run inline to its right, wrapping naturally, and on a phone the label sits above them. Every group is a list named by its own heading, all inside one Footer navigation. A link with external: true opens in a new tab and says so. social profiles show as round icon links when you give an icon from @rhs-ui/icons and as text links when you do not. Pass linkAs={Link} for your router's links, and navLabel and labels to translate the fixed words. Where FooterSection spreads groups across columns and FooterMinimal gives everything one row, this suits a few short groups: product, company, legal.
